cost_basis: gpt-4.1 list price $2.00/M input, $8.00/M output. `cost_estimate_usd` covers the uncached calls of the last run only; `cost_estimate_usd_total` sums every call ever written to judge-cache.jsonl, which is what the audit actually cost to produce.
policy: One policy for every failed supporting quote in every stratum: re-ask the judge for a verbatim supporting span with the answer supplied again; if the re-asked span verifies, keep the verdict with the repaired evidence; if it still fails, the unit is `unresolved` - neither the original verdict nor `absent`. Acceptance is verbatim (whitespace-normalised) OR matcher-normalised containment, so the gate is never stricter than protocol v1.
